source.title: Where do the files come from?
source.description: {appName} reads the files, rebuilds the folder structure and stores the messages as a new restore point of an imported mailbox.

folder.description: Use files that are already on the {appName} server, in {path}. Best for very large archives that you do not want to send through the browser.

disabled.description: No readable folder is mounted at {path}. Mount a directory there in the api and worker containers (read only is enough) or set IMPORT_DIR to the path you use, then reload this page. For example, add this to the volumes of both containers:

info.title: What can be imported
info.supported: Supported: EML (single messages), MSG (Outlook messages), MBOX and ZIP archives of these, as well as folders or ZIP files with EML or MSG messages, such as MailStore exports.
info.mailstore: MailStore's own archive format cannot be read. In MailStore, export the mailboxes as EML or MSG files (a folder or a ZIP) and import that.
info.pst: PST and OST files are planned for a later release. Until then, export the mailbox from Outlook as MSG or EML files, or convert it to MBOX, and import those.
info.calendar: Only mail is imported. Calendar entries and contacts are not, and an Outlook item that is a contact or an appointment is listed as not a mail message.
info.msg: MSG messages are rebuilt as EML from the properties stored in the file. Text, HTML, recipients and attachments are kept, but the result is not the original transport format byte for byte.

files.title: Choose the files
files.descriptionUpload: Add the files to import. They are sent to the {appName} server in encrypted pieces, so you can go on to the next step while they upload.
files.descriptionFolder: Select the files and folders of the import folder. A selected folder brings everything inside it.

table.title: Files
table.description: What each file contained and what became of it. The SHA-256 lets you check that a file is the one you meant to import.

upload.limit: Up to {size} per file. An interrupted upload continues where it stopped.
upload.folderDropped: {count, plural, one {A folder was skipped} other {# folders were skipped}}: folders cannot be uploaded. Add the files themselves, or put the folder into a ZIP first.
upload.duplicates: {count, plural, one {This file is already in the list.} other {# files are already in the list.}}

item.retrying: connection problem, trying again in {seconds} s (attempt {attempt})

errors.network: The server could not be reached, even after several tries. Check the connection and try again: the upload continues where it stopped.
errors.server: The server reported an error, even after several tries. Try again in a moment.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again; the upload can then continue where it stopped.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to upload files for this tenant.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than the limit of {limit}. Split it, or put it into the server import folder.
errors.gone: The upload no longer exists on the server, it may have expired. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.stagingFull: The space for files that wait for an import is full. Wait until an import has finished or remove an upload, then try again. Large files can also be put into the server import folder.
errors.conflict: The server no longer accepts data for this upload. Remove the file and add it again.
errors.corrupt: The data kept arriving damaged. Check the connection (a proxy may be changing the data) and try again.
errors.unreadable: The browser could not read the file. It may have been moved, deleted or changed since you chose it.
errors.unknown: The upload failed for an unknown reason.

pst_not_supported.title: PST and OST files cannot be imported yet
pst_not_supported.description: Importing PST and OST files is planned for a later release. Export the mailbox from Outlook as MSG or EML files, or convert it to MBOX, and import those.

unrecognised.title: This is not a supported mail file
unrecognised.description: {appName} looked at the content of the file and found no EML message, MSG message, MBOX file or ZIP archive. The name of the file does not matter, only its content.

refusal.notImported: The file is not part of the import.

unfinished.title: Unfinished uploads
unfinished.description: Uploads from an earlier visit that were not used yet. To continue an interrupted upload, add the same file again: it is recognized by name and size, and only the missing parts are sent.
unfinished.pickAgain: Add this file again to continue.

folder.loadError: The import folder could not be read

notEnabled.title: The import folder is not available
notEnabled.description: The server has no readable import folder. Ask the operator to mount one.

gone.title: This folder no longer exists
gone.description: It was moved or removed on the server.

reasons.pst: PST and OST files are planned for a later release.
reasons.unknown: Not recognized as a mail file.
reasons.other: This kind of file cannot be imported.

folder.truncated: Only the first {count} entries are shown. Open a subfolder, or select this folder as a whole.

target.title: Where should the messages go?
target.description: An imported mailbox is a mailbox in {appName} that only holds imported mail. Every import adds a new restore point to it and never removes what is already there.

new.title: Create a new imported mailbox
new.description: For a separate collection, for example one mailbox per former employee or per archive.
new.name: Name of the mailbox
new.hint: 1 to {max} characters. This is the name you will see in the restore explorer.

errors.tooLong: The name may have at most {max} characters.

existing.title: Add to an existing imported mailbox
existing.description: The new messages are added to what the mailbox already holds. Messages that are already there are skipped.
existing.none: There is no imported mailbox yet.
existing.hint: The same message is recognized and skipped, so importing a file twice does no harm.

archive.title: Also ingest into the archive (retention and search apply)
archive.description: Every imported message is also written to the archive, marked as imported from a file. Retention rules, legal holds and full-text search then apply to it like to any archived mail. Leave this off if the mail only needs to be restorable.

review.title: Review and start
review.description: Check the details. The import runs in the background: you can leave this page and follow it under Imports.
review.uploading: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} still uploading. You can start the import when all uploads have finished.
review.note: Messages that are already in the mailbox are skipped as duplicates. Calendar entries and contacts are not imported. Files that cannot be read are listed in the report, and everything else is imported.

job.title: Import
job.subtitle: Progress and report of this import.
job.loadError: The import could not be loaded

notFound.title: Import not found
notFound.description: This import does not exist or belongs to another tenant.

progress.title: Import in progress
progress.queued: Waiting for a worker to pick it up.
progress.label: Import progress
progress.counting: Counting what is in the files.
progress.messages: {count, plural, one {# message imported so far} other {# messages imported so far}}
progress.failed: {count, plural, one {# item failed} other {# items failed}}
progress.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# duplicate skipped} other {# duplicates skipped}}
progress.archive: {done} of {total} messages handed to the archive

outcome.title: Result
outcome.cancelledDescription: It stopped before finishing. Files uploaded for it were removed from the server, and earlier imports into the mailbox are not affected.
outcome.completedSnapshot: The messages are stored in a new restore point of the mailbox.
outcome.completedNoSnapshot: Nothing new was stored, for example because every message was already in the mailbox.
outcome.allAlreadyImported: {count, plural, one {The only message in the files was already imported. Nothing new was stored.} other {All # messages in the files were already imported. Nothing new was stored.}}
outcome.nothingStored: Nothing was stored because none of the files could be read. The list below says why.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.calendar_contacts_not_imported: Calendar entries and contacts are not imported, only mail. Outlook items that are contacts or appointments are listed as not a mail message.
notes.msg_reconstructed: Some messages come from MSG files and were rebuilt as EML from the stored properties. Their content and attachments are kept, but they are not the original transport format byte for byte.
notes.metadata_unavailable: Some messages are stored byte for byte, but their subject, sender and text could not be read in a reasonable time or with the memory the import allows, so they appear without those details and the archive search does not find their text. The messages themselves are complete.
notes.item_list_truncated: The list of items is capped, so more items exist than are shown.
notes.report_recovered: This report was rebuilt from the records of the job after the import was interrupted, for example by a restart. Some details, such as the list of failed or skipped items, may be missing.
notes.other: The import reported a note this version of {appName} does not know (code: {code}).

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: The result of ingesting the imported messages into the archive.
archive.pending: The messages are handed to the archive once the import is done.

items.title: Items that were not imported
items.description: Items that could not be read or were skipped, failed ones first. The reason is explained in your language, followed by the reader's original text.

codes.unreadable: The item is damaged or could not be parsed.
codes.unsupported: A format or container {appName} does not read, for example an encrypted or nested archive.
codes.not_mail: This is not a mail message, for example an index file, an image, or an Outlook contact or appointment.
codes.pst_not_supported: PST and OST files are planned for a later release.
codes.too_large: The message is larger than the limit for a single message.
codes.limit: A safety limit of the ZIP reader was reached: number of entries, expanded size or compression ratio.
codes.duplicate: The message is already in the mailbox.

items.copyFailed: The list could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
items.pending: Failures appear here while the import runs.
items.liveFailures: Items the import could not read so far:
items.noneNeeded: Every item was imported. There is nothing to report.
items.noneListed: The report did not list individual items.
items.omitted: {count, plural, one {# more item is} other {# more items are}} not listed. The list shows the first {listed}.

cancel.title: Cancel this import?
cancel.description: The import stops as soon as the worker reaches its next check. Files uploaded for it are removed from the server, and earlier imports into the mailbox are not affected.
cancel.failed: The import could not be cancelled
